text:
Maria: Need a concise plan for our private-alpha partner picks and feedback rhythm. Goal: 6 partners total, split sandbox/integration. Who can take outreach and legal?

Aj: Eng can support minimal hooks only. Recommend hosted-first and max 2 deep integrations concurrently.

Sophie: I'll own onboarding UX and welcome packet. Two tracks: sandbox (no infra) and integration (small config).

Tariq: CS can manage 6 partners; will run weekly 30m check-ins and collect Looms. I'll coordinate calendar invites.

Ravi: Legal: integrations need NDA + DPA two-pager; allow 2 business days. Note that in timeline.

Maria: Proposed outreach window: 7 days, accept 6 partners, ask 4 weeks active testing, weekly 30m check-ins, plus one mid-run survey. Also ask partners to save 3 failure examples for triage.

Aj: Telemetry minimal events: session_start, prompt_submission, response_ms, error_code, feedback_flag. Example: {"event":"response_ms","value":210,"route":"/v1/generate"}

Sophie: QA checklist for partners: 1) run sample prompt set, 2) confirm median latency < target on core route, 3) upload 3 example failures. I'll add this to the packet.

Tariq: Success criteria idea: onboarding completion >=80% within 3 days; weekly active sessions >=2; >=3 actionable asks from partners by week 4.

Maria: I'll include a small NPS pulse at week 4 and a regression flag: pause if partner sees >15% quality drop vs baseline.

Aj: Ops note: block one dev-day per integration for onboarding spikes. Route partners to hosted variants first to limit ops.

Ravi: I'll prepare NDA+DPA and post in the doc by Thu.

Maria: Action items: Aj: telemetry snippet + minimal SDK by Fri; Sophie: final invite + QA checklist by Thu; Tariq: partner shortlist + outreach schedule by Fri; Ravi: legal packet by Thu. I'll run scoring and publish invites next week.

beta-bot: Meeting created: "Private Alpha kickoff" Tue 10:00 PST (organizer: Maria).

Sophie: I'll add a 5-prompt sample set that highlights edge failures.

Maria: Thanks all, updating central doc and tagging owners. Flag changes here.
